verdict.rationale: Kit exposes audience tagging & segmentation as a feature and its API/broadcast endpoints can target existing segment or tag ids, plus an MCP server lets an AI client read/write to a Kit account via natural-language prompts becoming real account actions. However, there is no direct evidence of an API or MCP capability that creates or defines a *new* segment from a plain-language audience description — only pre-existing segment targeting is documented. Missing for 10: explicit segment-creation endpoint/tool, an example of natural-language-to-segment translation, and independent confirmation this specific workflow works.
